galleryItems.title: Modular Bedroom Wardrobe
galleryItems.description: Modern modular wardrobe with glossy finish
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Full-height modular wardrobe in high-gloss white paired with warm walnut accents. Features soft-close drawers, adjustable shelving, and an integrated LED strip along the hanging section for improved visibility — a sleek, space-efficient storage solution for contemporary bedrooms.

galleryItems.title: Cushioned Bed & Display Wardrobe
galleryItems.description: Luxurious bedroom setup with padded headboard
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Bedroom vignette centered on a tufted, cushioned headboard in a neutral fabric, flanked by built-in display niches with recessed lighting. The wardrobe combines open shelving and concealed storage in matte wood finishes with metal hardware to create a warm yet sophisticated atmosphere.

galleryItems.title: Cozy Room with Compact Storage
galleryItems.description: Sofa bed with wooden wardrobe and ambient lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Compact multi-purpose room featuring a convertible sofa bed and a slim floating wooden wardrobe with sliding doors. Warm recessed and accent lighting, plus efficient vertical storage, make the layout ideal for small apartments that need flexible sleeping and living zones.

galleryItems.title: Classic Corner Wardrobe
galleryItems.description: L-shaped wardrobe with warm lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: L-shaped corner wardrobe in an oak finish with integrated corner shelving and under-cabinet LED spotlights. The configuration maximizes corner space with dedicated hanging zones, deep drawers and a mirrored door to visually expand the room.

galleryItems.title: Stylish Wardrobe with Mirror Panel
galleryItems.description: Modern wardrobe with dual-tone wood finish
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Contemporary wardrobe with a full-height mirror panel and dual-tone veneer—natural wood grain paired with muted grey. The interior includes hanging zones, open display cubbies and concealed drawers for a balanced mix of organization and visual appeal.

galleryItems.title: Elegant Dining Area
galleryItems.description: Cozy dining set with wooden partition
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Refined dining area with a wooden partition that doubles as a display and storage unit, a medium-toned dining table and upholstered chairs. Layered lighting — pendant fixtures and cove LED — creates an intimate atmosphere suited for family meals and small gatherings.

galleryItems.title: Modern Glass-Top Dining Set
galleryItems.description: Contemporary glass dining set with cushioned chairs
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Minimalist dining arrangement centered around a tempered glass-top table with chrome-accented legs and cushioned chairs. Clean lines, reflective surfaces and neutral upholstery keep the space feeling open and modern.

galleryItems.title: Contemporary Wall-to-Wall Wardrobe
galleryItems.description: Sleek dual-tone wardrobe with curved shelves
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Wall-to-wall built-in wardrobe finished in a glossy two-tone palette with gently curved open shelves for display. The design incorporates flush handles, concealed shoe storage and dedicated accessory drawers to deliver a premium, seamless storage solution for a master bedroom.

galleryItems.title: Modern Cozy Living Room
galleryItems.description: Geometric ceiling with pastel blue accents
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Contemporary living room characterized by a geometric false ceiling in pastel blue tones, layered ambient lighting and a wall-mounted media unit. Soft furnishings and floating shelves balance the room to create a relaxed, stylish lounge area.

galleryItems.title: Bright Modern Modular Kitchen
galleryItems.description: Vibrant yellow and white cabinetry
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Bright modular kitchen with yellow and white lacquered cabinets, soft-close drawers and an efficient L-shaped layout. Integrated appliance bays, pull-out organizers and under-cabinet task lighting provide a practical, cheerful workspace.

galleryItems.title: Elegant Entryway Cabinet
galleryItems.description: Sleek storage with mirror and warm wood finish
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Entryway cabinet with a full-height mirror, slim console drawers and warm wood veneer. Integrated LED accents and recessed cubbies offer practical storage for shoes, keys and accessories while enhancing the foyer's visual warmth.

galleryItems.title: Open Modular Kitchen
galleryItems.description: Yellow and white with breakfast counter
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Open-plan kitchen featuring yellow upper cabinets, white lower units and a casual breakfast counter. The layout emphasizes workflow with designated prep zones, appliance niches and concealed storage to maintain a clutter-free look.

galleryItems.title: Contemporary TV Unit
galleryItems.description: Wall-mounted with ambient lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Sleek floating TV unit with backlit niches and integrated closed storage to conceal media equipment. Cable management channels and soft-touch finishes keep the entertainment area tidy while ambient lighting highlights decorative elements.

galleryItems.title: Elegant False Ceiling Design
galleryItems.description: Recessed design with warm cove lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: An elegant false ceiling with recessed drops and warm cove lighting that creates a soft, layered illumination. Paired with a dedicated dressing area and coordinated finishes, the setup evokes a premium, hotel-like bedroom experience.

galleryItems.title: Minimalist False Ceiling with Cove Lighting
galleryItems.description: Clean design with golden cove lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Minimalist false ceiling featuring subtle stepped coves and warm golden cove lighting that complements the room's streamlined interiors. The lighting scheme accentuates architectural lines while offering an inviting, ambient glow.

galleryItems.title: Wave-Inspired False Ceiling Design
galleryItems.description: Creative wave pattern with golden lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: A wave-inspired layered false ceiling with curved coves and linear LED accents that form a soft, rhythmic focal point. The bedroom below is furnished with coordinated cabinetry and indirect lighting for a calm, contemporary retreat.

galleryItems.title: Sleek Coffered Ceiling Design
galleryItems.description: Twin fans with warm cove lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Crisp white coffered ceiling with stepped coves, hidden LED strips and symmetrical recessed downlights. Two matching three-blade ceiling fans provide balanced airflow while the layered lighting enhances the room's architectural depth.

galleryItems.title: LED Cove Ceiling with Recessed Lights & TV Wall Unit
galleryItems.description: Contemporary TV wall with wood veneer cabinets and integrated LED cove ceiling
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Entertainment wall combining a wall-mounted TV flanked by symmetrical storage cabinets and open display shelves. The ceiling above features perimeter LED cove lighting and recessed downlights to create layered ambient illumination; concealed wiring and a matte wood finish keep the composition clean and modern.

galleryItems.title: Designer square shaped false ceiling
galleryItems.description: Square-frame false ceiling with warm LED cove lighting and central fan
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Designer square-frame false ceiling with stepped drops and warm LED cove lighting around the perimeter. A modern three-blade ceiling fan sits at the center, accompanied by recessed downlights to provide both style and practical illumination for living or bedroom areas.

galleryItems.title: Living space with two-tone cabinets
galleryItems.description: Two-tone kitchen cabinetry with granite countertop and efficient layout
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Functional two-tone kitchen featuring white upper cabinets paired with darker lower units and a polished granite countertop. The layout includes an integrated sink, full-height pantry and under-cabinet task lighting to optimize workflow and storage in a compact footprint.

galleryItems.title: Modular Kitchen
galleryItems.description: Open-plan living area with modular kitchen and geometric ceiling
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Open living and dining area anchored by a modular kitchen with handle-less cabinetry, a breakfast counter, and coordinated finishes. A striking geometric false ceiling visually ties the spaces together while offering layered lighting options for cooking and entertaining.

galleryItems.title: Wooden TV Cabinet
galleryItems.description: Custom wooden TV cabinet with display niches and concealed storage
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Full-height wooden media cabinet combining wardrobe-like storage with a media console: rich wood-grain veneer, mirrored accents and integrated accent lighting. The design includes open display shelves, deep drawers and concealed compartments ideal for storing electronics and accessories.

galleryItems.title: Modern square shaped Designer Ceiling
galleryItems.description: Square designer ceiling with LED perimeter lighting and recessed downlights
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Contemporary square ceiling with stepped layers, LED perimeter lighting and strategically placed recessed downlights. A central three-blade fan complements the clean lines, making this ceiling suitable for both formal and casual interior settings.

galleryItems.title: Luxurious 'L' Shaped Wooden Cabinet
galleryItems.description: Elegant L-shaped wooden cabinet and wardrobe with strategic lighting
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Custom L-shaped cabinetry in warm wood tones offering a mix of open shelving, drawer storage and hanging zones. Integrated display lighting highlights decorative items while the minimal profiles and concealed handles maintain a refined, contemporary bedroom aesthetic.

galleryItems.title: Elegant living space with mirror panels
galleryItems.description: Floor-to-ceiling wardrobe with mirror panels and illuminated niches
galleryItems.detailedDescription: Luxurious floor-to-ceiling wardrobe system with rich wood veneers, full-length mirrored panels and backlit display niches. Internally fitted organizers, soft-close hardware and concealed lighting combine to create an organized, visually striking bedroom feature wall.
